title: Configure Feishu
modeWebSocketDesc: Real-time push with the lightest setup. Recommended for most deployments.
modeWebhookDesc: Receive events through a public callback endpoint when you already have ingress.
pluginNotInstalled: The Feishu plugin is missing or disabled. Confirm the plugin is available before continuing.
appIdHint: App ID from the Feishu developer console
appIdHelp: Copy the App ID from your Feishu developer console.
appSecretHint: App Secret from the Feishu developer console
appSecretHelp: Copy the App Secret from your Feishu developer console.
testDesc: Save the configuration first, then test the connection to verify your credentials.
probeConfigNote: Click "Complete" to save before testing. The probe checks the live gateway state.
